narrative.overview: Sprout is a cool dusk forest with one source of warmth. Against the cool field, amber light is reserved for the things that matter: Tomorrow's Lantern, the one thing that glows; the primary action is a small closed journal. The night scene is the cover; the panels are the pages. Components should feel tactile and bookish.
keyCharacteristics: Cool dusk field; warm amber light belongs to the Lantern alone.
Pale paper panels beside the scenery, never modals over it.
Three type voices with strict jobs: heading (IM Fell), story (Alegreya), interface (Alegreya Sans).
Slow, quiet ambient motion; one polished moment (the leaf flying onto its tree).
Plain language over metaphor in every label.

rules.name: The One Lantern Rule
rules.body: Only the Lantern glows. Amber elsewhere is thread-thin (focus, selection), never a fill.

rules.name: The Plain Error Rule
rules.body: Berry appears only when something went wrong or is about to be removed.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: IM Fell only leads a screen; Alegreya only carries names and the user's words; Alegreya Sans does everything else. Never set UI controls in a serif. The one control set in a serif is the journal button, whose label is the title of the book.

rules.name: The Their Words Rule
rules.body: Anything quoted from the journal is set in Alegreya inside curly quotes, upright. Italic is reserved for the surrounding context when an entry is expanded.

rules.name: The Night Weight Rule
rules.body: Light text on dusk steps up one weight (500) so it doesn't thin out.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Importance is shown with light (amber glow) before elevation. No glowing halos without offset on cards; glow belongs to light sources.

dos: Do keep amber light for the Lantern; elsewhere amber is only thread (focus, selection).
Do put reading and writing on paper panels beside the Grove, keeping the Grove visible.
Do set every user quote in Alegreya inside curly quotes.
Do keep every floating control on the 24px frame and bottom-aligned with its row.
Do honor reduced motion: the scenery holds still, fireflies stay as soft lights.
donts: Don't show streaks, scores, percentages, or wilting.
Don't set interface controls in IM Fell or Alegreya.
Don't use berry for anything but errors and removal.
Don't use typed glyphs or emoji as icons; draw them in the shared 1.75 stroke.
Don't cover the Grove with a modal for tasks that a side panel can hold.
